missing_evidence: Redis-side telemetry (latency, errors, saturation) for the same window to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory p95/error-rate baseline before the window to show the increase
candidates.statement: Inventory's redis.reserve_inventory calls time out (1350ms, ERROR), producing 7 redis_operation_timeout 504 errors and 18 dependency timeouts; gateway's call to inventory then errors at ~1953ms, driving checkout error-rate and latency.
candidates.uncertainty: Redis server-side cause (saturation vs network) not observed; only client-side timeouts seen.

report.explanation: Inventory traces and logs show redis operation timeouts with elevated dependency timeouts and p95, and gateway traces show the failing downstream call to inventory. Order and gateway logs/metrics remain healthy, so the bounded candidate is a redis timeout at inventory. Deployment record alone does not establish causation.
